target_types.SECTOR: industry such as RMG, banking, agriculture, energy or imports/exports of a named sector
target_types.COMPANY: a named company, bank or business organization
target_types.REGULATOR: Bangladesh government economic policy, ministry, central bank, tax/statistics authority or international policy institution
target_types.MACRO_INDICATOR: GDP, inflation, remittance, reserves, exchange rate, policy rate, employment, purchasing power, aggregate imports/exports or trade balance

exclusion_policy.non_evaluative: financially relevant but no evaluative polarity
exclusion_policy.review_required: ambiguous status, target, span, or polarity; human decision required
